review_notes: I read the whole file. Most theorems are one-line wrappers around CircleKernelConvolution lemmas. Those wrappers don't repeat any proof machinery. Only two proofs have real bodies: approximationCoefficient_norm_le_one (a product-of-norms bound) and continuous_approximation (continuity of a finite Fourier sum). I grepped the working tree for the continuity argument (the continuous_finsetSum / continuous_const.mul pattern) and found it only here. The norm bound is a short calculation, so neither proof meets the rubric's bar for repeated nontrivial reasoning. I did not search the other files in the project for other proofs that restate the same polynomial-continuity argument in a different form.
